verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents one built-in recurring mechanism: it creates a 'pending' case review that reopens automatically when the next review is due, typically after 90 days. It also mentions customizable automation for ongoing monitoring. There is no evidence of a general facility for users to define their own recurring jobs or workflows, and workflow configuration appears to be done by Hummingbird on the customer's behalf. Missing for 10: user-defined recurring schedules (cron or interval) for arbitrary jobs, schedule management via UI or API, documentation of configurable cadence, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Hummingbird creates a "pending" review of the case that will automatically open when it's time to review the case again (typically 90 days).
Streamline your onboarding, ongoing monitoring, or ad-hoc investigations using customizable automation
